# POLISHED.
> Premium Visual Identities for Skincare Brands | BANGLADESH

## Core Identity
- Founder: Ehsanul Hoque
- Tagline: Make Your Collection Unmissable!
- Target Niche: Exclusively partnering with e-commerce-based Skincare Stores operating in Bangladesh.
- Brand Voice: "The Sophisticated Expert" - Classy, Direct, and Confident.

## The POLISHED Solution & Philosophy
- We are pioneering the "Premium Bengali" aesthetic. We pair high-end, sophisticated Bengali copywriting with world-class, elegant visual design to build immense trust and a premium perception. We avoid broken English or cheap-looking Bengali visuals.

## Typography & Vibe
- Vibe: Premium, Quiet Luxury, Minimalist.
- English Font: Classic Serif (Cormorant Garamond).
- Bengali Font: Noto Serif Bengali.

## Core Services
1. E-commerce Visual Strategy: Crafting trust-building assets for storefronts.
2. High-Conversion Social Media Design: Turning scrollers into buyers.
